gate_evidence.gist_srcdoc: The Store emitted-JavaScript gate parses source structure and rejects a literal remote gist.github.com script URL in an iframe srcDoc initializer. Tests cover installed/minified source shapes, false-positive cases, and gate refusal for an emitted chunk.
gate_evidence.pdfobject: The known jsPDF PDFObject script-src loader test remains in the suite, including gate refusal after minifier-style script-handle renaming.
gate_evidence.independent_review: Approved by independent AST scanner review; the reviewer reported 6/6 focused tests passing, targeted Biome clean, the installed tldraw source detected, and an emitted-output inventory with one Gist hit.

limits: The Gist detector is a narrow static guard for a literal remote script URL inside a TypeScript AST srcDoc property initializer; it does not prove the absence of other dynamically assembled remote-code paths.
